projectionReceipt.description: Digest-bound authority reference for projectionReceiptBytesBase64; the runtime recomputes and compares the exact UTF-8 byte digest before reading receipt fields.

sha256:a4991834c66974c87d57541ad00f2e6fb.description: The state record for executing a capability from a capsule.

declaredScenarios.description: The disassembled scenario set. Optional when a canonical blueprint conditions the request; supplied here it is cross-checked against that blueprint rather than believed.

declaredTopology.description: Designed topology. Routes, variants, convergence and precedence are authored meaning and are never derived by the scaffold.

provenance.description: Where this topology came from. Archetype instantiation binds identities and configuration only; geometry is immutable.

canonicalBlueprint.description: The canonical circuit blueprint conditioning this scaffold. When supplied, scenarios, terminals, routes, ordinals, altitudes, observability, binding authority and projection authorities are read from it, and no competing circuit is emitted.

kind.description: The blueprint node vocabulary is owned by the canonical circuit blueprint contract. Constraining it here would let a scaffold reject an admitted design it simply had not seen before.

anyOf.description: The scaffold admitted at each downstream scenario boundary, where the carrier is the previously admitted outcome.

blueprintAuthorityRef.description: Exact authority digest of the blueprint being projected.

blueprintCarrierBytesBase64.description: The exact canonical-circuit-blueprint.v1 carrier bytes. Projection reads only these bytes, so it can never describe a blueprint it was not given.

anyOf.description: The projection bundle admitted at each downstream scenario boundary, where the carrier is the previously admitted outcome.
One provisioning batch, its observed artifacts, and the artifact catalog that classifies them. Walking a tree and scanning bytes are effects performed elsewhere; what arrives here is observation.

selections.description: What the batch declared it was provisioning. An empty selection set is a failure to declare, never a batch that selected nothing.

policyAllowances.description: Explicit exceptions. Each must name both the artifact and the rule it excuses; an allowance naming neither is unbounded and is itself a finding.

digestShard.description: The content-address shard of the digest. Reported by the observer because the admitted transformation vocabulary cannot take a substring.

policyScreen.description: The secret policy screen already applied to the bytes. Supplied as testimony because pattern matching is not an admitted transformation operation.

declaredArtifactCatalog.description: The declared binding of extension to artifact type, language and media type. Classification is read from here, never inferred.

anyOf.description: The provisioning decision admitted at each downstream scenario boundary, where the carrier is the previously admitted outcome.

sha256:6c82f0631637e28e92c311efef2e6dd28.title: SideFX evidence receipt publication record v1

suppliedFixtureCandidates.description: Fixture candidates offered by a caller. A candidate carrying a concrete domain value has decided the answer rather than declared the obligation.

anyOf.description: The obligation set admitted at each downstream scenario boundary, where the carrier is the previously admitted outcome.
One presented estate inventory. Extraction of capsules from durable storage is an effect boundary this capability does not own; it resolves the closure of whatever inventory it is given.

capsules.description: Every admitted capsule the estate presents. An empty array is a failure to present an estate, never an estate that has achieved closure.

applicationBinding.description: The target's runtime application binding, recanonicalized and rehashed on every resolution rather than trusted from its recorded digest.

bindingRef.description: The admitted capability this dependency resolves to. Name agreement alone is never accepted as resolution.

anyOf.description: The closure admitted at each downstream scenario boundary, where the carrier is the previously admitted outcome.
